title.zh: 【CoinDCX 称旧钱包链上活动与当前运营无关，ZachXBT 质疑其仍用于归集用户存款】
title.en: CoinDCX Faces Suspected $16 Million Hack After $44 Million Breach in 2025

current_state.zh: CoinDCX 已承认因旧 compromised 钱包存款转出流程失败而产生运营损失，并称受影响账户已补记、当前钱包安全；但围绕约 1600 万美元可疑转账及旧地址是否仍被使用的争议仍在持续监测中。
current_state.en: CoinDCX has admitted operational losses from a failed process to move deposits out of previously compromised wallets, saying affected accounts were credited and current wallets are safe; scrutiny continues over the roughly $16 million in suspicious transfers and whether old addresses remained in use.

updates.title_zh: CoinDCX Faces Suspected $16 Million Hack After $44 Million Breach in 2025
updates.title_en: CoinDCX Faces Suspected $16 Million Hack After $44 Million Breach in 2025
updates.what_changed_zh: 链上调查人员标记约 1600 万美元的 USDT 和 TRX 从 CoinDCX 热钱包和充值地址流向一个 TRON 地址，随后被拆分转往 Binance、OKX 和 Gate 的充值地址；这家印度交易所此前在 2025 年 7 月损失约 4400 万美元，此次疑似遭入侵尚未得到证实。
updates.what_changed_en: On-chain investigators flagged roughly $16 million in USDT and TRX flowing from CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a single TRON address before being split toward Binance, OKX and Gate deposit addresses, an unconfirmed breach at the Indian exchange that previously lost about $44 million in July 2025.
updates.current_state_zh: 链上调查人员标记约 1600 万美元的 USDT 和 TRX 从 CoinDCX 热钱包和充值地址流向一个 TRON 地址，随后被拆分转往 Binance、OKX 和 Gate 的充值地址；这家印度交易所此前在 2025 年 7 月损失约 4400 万美元，此次疑似遭入侵尚未得到证实。

updates.detailed_summary_en: On-chain investigators flagged roughly $16 million in USDT and TRX flowing from CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a single TRON address before being split toward Binance, OKX and Gate deposit addresses, an unconfirmed breach at the Indian exchange that previously lost about $44 million in July 2025.

updates.title_zh: 【CoinDCX 称旧钱包链上活动与当前运营无关，ZachXBT 质疑其仍用于归集用户存款】
updates.title_en: 【CoinDCX 称旧钱包链上活动与当前运营无关，ZachXBT 质疑其仍用于归集用户存款】
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDCX 回应称相关链上活动来自 2025 年 7 月已被入侵且此后停用的旧钱包，与当前运营无关；ZachXBT 则质疑该旧充值地址直至 2026 年仍被流动性提供商用于接收 Gas 并归集用户存款至 CoinDCX 当前公开热钱包。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX responded that the on-chain activity involved old wallets compromised in July 2025 and unused since, unrelated to current operations; ZachXBT disputed this, alleging a linked deposit address was still used by a liquidity provider through 2026 to receive gas and consolidate user deposits into CoinDCX’s current public hot wallet.
updates.current_state_zh: CoinDCX 否认旧钱包活动影响当前运营并称用户资金安全，但 ZachXBT 对旧充值地址是否仍用于归集用户存款提出质疑；此前约 1599 万 USDT 转入 TRON 地址的事件仍处于争议和监测中。
updates.current_state_en: CoinDCX denies that the old-wallet activity affects current operations and says user funds are safe, while ZachXBT disputes whether a linked deposit address was still used to consolidate user deposits; the earlier roughly 15.99 million USDT transfer to a TRON address remains disputed and under monitoring.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CoinDCX said recent on-chain activity tied to wallets compromised in July 2025 is unrelated to its current operations, while ZachXBT alleged that a deposit address linked to the old incident continued receiving gas and consolidating user deposits into CoinDCX’s current public hot wallet through 2026, following a roughly 15.99 million USDT transfer from CoinDCX wallets to a TRON address on October 21.
updates.detailed_summary_en: CoinDCX said recent on-chain activity tied to wallets compromised in July 2025 is unrelated to its current operations, while ZachXBT alleged that a deposit address linked to the old incident continued receiving gas and consolidating user deposits into CoinDCX’s current public hot wallet through 2026, following a roughly 15.99 million USDT transfer from CoinDCX wallets to a TRON address on October 21.

updates.title_zh: 【Salus CMO 质疑 CoinDCX 的旧钱包解释，称最新储备证明所列地址向疑似黑客地址转账】
updates.title_en: 【Salus CMO 质疑 CoinDCX 的旧钱包解释，称最新储备证明所列地址向疑似黑客地址转账】
updates.what_changed_zh: Salus 首席营销官 Darcy 进一步质疑 CoinDCX 的旧钱包解释，称 CoinDCX 最新储备证明中列出的两个地址曾向疑似黑客地址转账，且其中一个热钱包在所称攻击事件前后持续分发 15 TRX 用于支付链上手续费；部分资金流向币安、OKX、Gate 及与 Huione、Xinbi 有关的地址。
updates.what_changed_en: Salus CMO Darcy further disputed CoinDCX’s legacy-wallet explanation, alleging that two addresses listed in CoinDCX’s latest proof of reserves sent funds to suspected hacker addresses and that one hot wallet kept distributing 15 TRX for gas around the alleged incident, with some funds flowing to Binance, OKX, Gate and Huione/Xinbi-linked addresses.
updates.current_state_zh: CoinDCX 否认旧钱包活动影响当前运营并称用户资金安全，但 ZachXBT 质疑相关充值地址仍被用于归集用户存款，Salus 首席营销官 Darcy 又指最新储备证明所列地址向疑似黑客地址转账；该疑似约 1600 万美元入侵事件仍处于争议和监测中。
updates.current_state_en: CoinDCX denies that the old-wallet activity affects current operations and says user funds are safe, but ZachXBT disputes whether a linked deposit address was still used to consolidate user deposits, and Salus CMO Darcy alleges that addresses in the latest proof of reserves sent funds to suspected hacker addresses; the suspected roughly $16 million breach remains disputed and under monitoring.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Salus CMO Darcy disputed CoinDCX's claim that the recent suspicious transfers involved only a deactivated legacy wallet, alleging that two addresses in the exchange's latest proof of reserves sent funds to suspected hacker addresses and that one hot wallet kept distributing 15 TRX for gas around the time of the alleged incident, with some funds flowing to Binance, OKX, Gate and Huione/Xinbi-linked addresses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Salus CMO Darcy disputed CoinDCX's claim that the recent suspicious transfers involved only a deactivated legacy wallet, alleging that two addresses in the exchange's latest proof of reserves sent funds to suspected hacker addresses and that one hot wallet kept distributing 15 TRX for gas around the time of the alleged incident, with some funds flowing to Binance, OKX, Gate and Huione/Xinbi-linked addresses.

updates.title_zh: CoinDCX 在 1600 万美元钱包转账引发审查后承认“运营损失”
updates.title_en: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDCX 承认，因未能及时将用户存款从 2025 年 7 月已被入侵的钱包转出，发生了“运营损失”，并称损失由 CoinDCX 吸收、所有受影响账户已获补记；同时坚称当前钱包未受影响、活跃钱包资金未被盗、客户资产仍在隔离冷钱包中。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX admitted “operational losses” after failing to sweep user deposits out of wallets compromised in its July 2025 hack, saying it absorbed the losses and credited all affected accounts, while maintaining that current wallets were unaffected, no active-wallet funds were compromised and customer assets remained in segregated cold wallets.
updates.current_state_zh: CoinDCX 已承认因旧 compromised 钱包存款转出流程失败而产生运营损失，并称受影响账户已补记、当前钱包安全；但围绕约 1600 万美元可疑转账及旧地址是否仍被使用的争议仍在持续监测中。
updates.current_state_en: CoinDCX has admitted operational losses from a failed process to move deposits out of previously compromised wallets, saying affected accounts were credited and current wallets are safe; scrutiny continues over the roughly $16 million in suspicious transfers and whether old addresses remained in use.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CoinDCX acknowledged operational losses after failing to sweep user deposits out of wallets compromised in its July 2025 hack, following scrutiny of about $16 million in suspicious transfers, and said it has credited all affected accounts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: CoinDCX acknowledged operational losses after failing to sweep user deposits out of wallets compromised in its July 2025 hack, following scrutiny of about $16 million in suspicious transfers, and said it has credited all affected accounts.
